answer: Each answer can carry a small deposit held until graders settle it. Randomly drawn graders read the text; if the median grade is below 2, the deposit is burned, otherwise it is refunded with the reward. Whether the prompt mentions cedar, ivory or ocean, the check is the same: is the mechanism real? A farm of 100 identities must lock 100 deposits, and each copied or empty answer burns one, so splitting multiplies losses instead of payouts. Limit: deposits must scale with rewards, or a rich attacker treats burns as a cost.
